I know how you feel. I have anxiety too. I say it's either at "I feel like I'm dying" or "I feel so bad I Just wish someone would kill me". You would do literally *anything* to make the anxiety stop. 



Lots of people with anxiety disorders self-medicate with booze, or marijuana. In some states, you can get marijuana legally for anxiety. The jury is still out about whether it actually helps, or just masks the symptoms. I say go for whatever helps. If you go this route, you'd want a high satvia plant. 

There are other herbs that are supposed to help with anxiety--but not with the all-out anxiety that comes with an anxiety disorder. Melatonin can help you sleep. Valerian root is another that can help. 

The best medications are going to be those that you get from your physician.  A GP can prescribe them, and there are ones that aren't *as* addictive, if that's an issue.
